comment: Phase 2d FINAL FROZEN PIN (objective-grid-corrected, 2026-07-08). HARNESS_SEED=0x4D524443. Both FEASIBILITY (Phase 2c L-polygon via footInside) and OBJECTIVE EVALUATION (Phase 2d) now respect the 6-vertex L-polygon. The SE notch is represented as a structural wall (notch_blocker) so the ADA/egress/noise objective grids treat those cells as blocked/attenuated the same way they treat any wall — no engine edit. This is the WSC poster freeze. See supersession chain for the full history.
geometry: 6-vertex L-polygon respected by BOTH feasibility (footInside) and objective grids (ADA/egress/noise via the notch wall).
stage_note: [A1] RESOLVED: 96.6 ft x 88.6 ft bounding box, 6-vertex L-shaped polygon, shoelace area 6278.8 sf. Source: GT MRDC drawing 1615813303111-2nd_floor_MRDC__3_.pdf, 9 pts/ft.
dba_source: Real per-tool values from default-elements.json. Proxy (70 + 5*risk) removed in Phase 0, Task 5.

enforced_run_summary.note: Objective-grid-corrected 4000-iter run at seed 0x4D524443. Baseline objectives now describe the real L-room (notch excluded/attenuated).

notch_blocker.note: Structural wall filling the excluded SE notch. Makes sim_ada/_egress mark those cells blocked (removed from the walkable/BFS grids) and sim_noise rasterize them into the STC grid (attenuation). Rect corner = L-polygon reflex vertex, extended to the stage edge. Defined in testcase/hub/mrdc2323-scale.json (notchBlockerDef); no engine edit.

objective_movement_vs_phase2c.note: Before (Phase 2c, objectives over full bounding box) -> After (Phase 2d, objectives over real L-room).

ada.why: notch cells removed from the ADA walkable-area denominator; failing cells are a larger fraction of the real floor.

egress.why: the as-is exitS sits inside the excluded notch; walling the notch isolates it, leaving exitN as the effective exit and raising max travel distance.

noise.why: the notch wall (STC 35 dB) attenuates sound propagating into/through the notch, removing some action-level cells; noise denominator is the full grid by design, so this is attenuation, not cell-exclusion.

infeasible.why: footInside (Phase 2c) already excluded the notch from feasibility; the blocker's collision effect is only the 0.3%-inset boundary sliver, so feasibility is essentially unchanged (+1 infeasible move). The front change is driven by the objective correction, not feasibility.

front.why: the worse (more realistic) baseline leaves more headroom and the egress surface now varies with exit routing, so more non-dominated solutions are found; all still dominate the baseline.

noise_stability.note: Noise objective under the CORRECTED (Phase 2d) grids, 10 documented seeds. Values changed from Phase 2c because the notch wall attenuates propagation. ADA (13.83%) and egress (42.75%) are identical across all 10 seeds (seed-independent). Cite noise improvements against this mean (39.10%); cite determinism against the pinned value (40.59%, seed 0x4D524443).

canary.note: ADA/egress checked against exact pinned values (±5 pp). Noise checked against the stability mean with tolerance = spread + 2 pp margin, computed from noise_stability. Tolerance recomputed for Phase 2d: spread 4.399 pp + 2 pp = 6.399 pp.

superseded.phase: Phase 2c — polygon-enforced FEASIBILITY, objectives still over bounding box
superseded.reason: Feasibility (footInside) respected the L-polygon, but evaluateLayout's ADA/egress/noise grids still iterated the full bounding box, counting the notch as usable floor. Superseded by the Phase 2d objective-grid correction (notch wall). Baseline moved 10.37/30.25/41.68 -> 13.83/42.75/40.59; front 10 -> 18.

superseded.phase: Phase 1 — bounding-box pin ([A1] resolved, but SE notch NOT enforced)
superseded.reason: The L-shaped floor zone was wiped from state.zones by the state.zones reset in mosa_validate.mjs, so getAnalysisRooms() returned [] and pointInAnalysisScope() degenerated to the full 96.6 x 88.6 ft bounding box. Feasibility never enforced the notch. Superseded by the polygon-enforced Phase 2c pin.
